generated_from.structure: caption files re-scored by hand (16 videos); scored.json used only as a candidate generator

caveats: Timestamps are reliable; classifications are judgement calls made by reading the surrounding sentence.
Auto-captions mis-transcribe proper nouns (Avimor -> 'Avonmore', Margaritaville -> 'Margaritavville', 'Mr. Beach' -> 'your Beach').
View counts in the channel listing files are rounded by YouTube; exemplars.json counts are exact.
Two videos (NOSAZ2h7UUY, H3jUbpNT2Zw) had no retrievable captions and are metadata-only.
scored.json's own first_price field contains false positives and should not be used directly.

videos.title: Affordable 55+ Communities in Central Florida (Waterfront, Low HOA & More!)
videos.first_price_quote: what are the price ranges you can find in there? Mid 100s to the high 200s.
videos.what_to_steal: 58,697 views on 15 minutes. Affordability is the entire premise, so the band arrives at 1:21 and then repeats for every community — 38 separate price mentions.

videos.title: Del Webb at Viera Florida - The Amazing 55+ Amenity Center! - Living in Melbourne Florida
videos.channel: Living in Melbourne Florida — David Jelinek
videos.what_to_steal: 26 minutes about an amenity centre with no price spoken at all, and it outperforms his priced map tour 4:1 on views. Amenities are a separate video from cost.

videos.title: The Villages Florida | Tour the #1 Retirement community in the world.
videos.what_to_steal: 313,608 views, 12:10, twelve chapters, zero prices. The outlier of the set and the one video here that is genuinely tourism content rather than lead generation — worth understanding, not copying.

videos.title: A Full Tour of Margaritaville Panama City Beach  — The Ultimate 55+ Resort Community
videos.channel: Living on the Emerald Coast, Florida w/ Mr. Beach
videos.first_price_quote: How much do these cottages run? — They start about 330, 340.
videos.callout_quote: Hey guys, what's up? It's Mr. Beach hanging out with you today in beautiful Margaritaville.
videos.note: An appreciation anecdote ($200,000 more than he bought it) lands at 8:06 / 16%, but it is not a price for anything on offer.
videos.what_to_steal: The single highest-viewed Latitude Watersound video in the set, and it is 42 minutes of two people walking and talking. Cadence, not polish.

videos.title: Inside Florida's BEST 55+ Community - Margaritaville Daytona Beach
videos.channel: Living in New Smyrna Beach FL
videos.first_price_quote: two-twos at the low end at 375 and on the high end you've got three-threes at 2,500 ft
videos.what_to_steal: A Margaritaville community tour that gives the price spread at 1:53 and then spends the rest of the video on lifestyle. Directly analogous subject matter to Karen's.

videos.title: Buying a Home in Florida: 7 Things You MUST Know in 2026
videos.channel: Living on the Emerald Coast, Florida w/ Mr. Beach
videos.callout_quote: If you're thinking about buying a home…
videos.what_to_steal: A worked-example price at 1:18 that exists only to make the tax and insurance maths concrete. Price here is a unit of measurement, not a payoff.

videos.title: Cape Coral Florida's BIGGEST Dealbreaker When Buying a Home
videos.channel: Living in Fort Myers Florida — Craig Cunha
videos.first_price_quote: If you want a home that's under a million or if you want a home that's under 800,000, you're going to sacrifice some of these things
videos.note: Renovation costs ($90,000 for a remodel, $4,500 to paint) appear at 7:20, before any home price.
videos.what_to_steal: Builds the whole video around what a price point costs you in features. The trade-off framing is transferable to phases: what you give up, not what it costs.

videos.title: Tour this NEW Boise Home with INSANELY MASSIVE RV Garage W/ SECRET ROOM
videos.channel: Living in Idaho Homes — Rachel Dau
videos.first_price_quote: custom luxury homes, and I'm talking $3 million and up
videos.callout_quote: If you've been thinking about relocating…
videos.note: The 28:21 mention is a contrast about other builders' homes, immediately corrected on camera ('this house is nowhere near $3 million'). The actual reveal is at 32:30.
videos.what_to_steal: Her best performer. The reveal sits in the last 11 seconds of 32:41 — 99% through. This is the home-tour discipline working exactly as taught.

videos.title: Tour this SHOCKINGLY AFFORDABLE Home in TOP Boise Master-Planned Community [AVIMOR]
videos.channel: Living in Idaho Homes — Rachel Dau
videos.first_price_quote: …with views like this for under a million dollars
videos.callout_quote: If you've been thinking about relocating to the Boise, Idaho area…
videos.channel_junkies_reference: Day 3 second example — Jesse's 'slightly wrong' closing
videos.note: Affordability is the hook, so a price BAND appears at 0:12 while the NUMBER is held to 28:24. This is the framework's own sanctioned exception, executed exactly.
videos.what_to_steal: The teaching asset. Its closing is quoted verbatim in the Day 3 material, including $969,880, and it is the video Jesse marks down for redirecting before revealing.

videos.title: Confused About Phases? Your Latitude Margaritaville Watersound Map Explained
videos.callout_quote: Hey friends, Robert McWiggan here with Watersound Real Estate.
videos.what_to_steal: Nothing to steal — this is the benchmark to beat. 6:55, no call-out, no price, no chapters, one spoken CTA at 2:09 and nothing after it.

videos.title: EVERY New Home Area in Viera Florida Right Now! | Living in Melbourne Florida
videos.channel: Living in Melbourne Florida — David Jelinek
videos.first_price_quote: over 100 new construction opportunities ranging from 400,000 up to over 1.5 million. And that's a price range that almost anybody can afford.
videos.callout_quote: If you are thinking about moving to Florida and want a brand new home in one of the most desirable master-planned communities…
videos.what_to_steal: The closest structural template to Karen's phases video that exists. Textbook call-out at 0:00, price range at 0:17 as orientation, and a re-hook ('wait till the end') inside the first 30 seconds.

videos.title: Inside Margaritaville Panama City Beach (What They Don’t Tell You)
videos.channel: Living on the Emerald Coast, Florida w/ Mr. Beach
videos.first_price_quote: These are the most affordable option here. These start in the 350s.
videos.callout_quote: Hey guys, this is [Mr.] Beach here.
videos.what_to_steal: Price band 98 seconds in, then four model walkthroughs back to back. The band is the orientation device; no single home price is ever given because the video is selling the collection, not a listing.

videos.title: Living in Cocoa Beach Florida! Here's What 40 Years of Living Here Taught Me!
videos.channel: Living in Melbourne Florida — David Jelinek
videos.first_price_quote: the average home is going to be about 700,000 … you can get homes in the 300s and they'll go up to, of course, to 4 million
videos.what_to_steal: His best performer, and the positioning is pure tenure: 40 years of living there. Karen's Phase 8 residency is the same asset.

videos.title: The Pros and Cons of Living in Boise Idaho in 2026... Watch this first before moving here!
videos.channel: Living in Idaho Homes — Rachel Dau
videos.first_price_quote: The days of stumbling onto a beautiful home here for $300,000, they're gone. The median home price in Ada County … is sitting right around $535,000 in 2026.
videos.callout_quote: You clicked on this video because you are interested in learning more about relocating to the Boise Idaho area.
videos.what_to_steal: The cleanest proof that the price rule is format-bound: same presenter as the 99% home tour, price at 13% here. Also a model of the 'cons first, and I love you enough to say it' framing.

videos.title: Cape Coral Florida Relocation Guide 2026
videos.channel: Living in Fort Myers Florida — Craig Cunha
videos.note: No captions were retrievable, so nothing structural was measured. Metadata only.
videos.what_to_steal: 44:26 on one city. The 'everything before you move here' guide is the format that justifies extreme length.

videos.title: Top 5 55+ Communities in Melbourne Florida – Prices, Amenities & Lifestyle
videos.channel: Living in Melbourne Florida — David Jelinek
videos.first_price_quote: starts at about 1,900 square ft … starts at about 550, 600,000
videos.callout_quote: If you're 55 or better and dreaming of warm weather, pickleball courts, and never having to shovel snow again…
videos.what_to_steal: A price band attached to every one of the five communities, first at 5:20. In a comparison video the band IS the comparison — withholding it would break the format.

videos.title: ULTIMATE GUIDE to Each Town on The Space Coast!  Don't Move to the Wrong Area!
videos.channel: Living in Melbourne Florida — David Jelinek
videos.note: No captions were retrievable, so nothing structural was measured. Metadata only.
videos.what_to_steal: 19 chapters — the most chaptered video in the set, and one of Jelinek's best performers at 6,108 views. Evidence that chapters and long-form reference content go together.

videos.title: Is AVIMOR Boise's BEST Community To Live in? [Full Vlog Tour]
videos.channel: Living in Idaho Homes — Rachel Dau
videos.first_price_quote: In Eagle, Idaho, the median home price is $986,000 as of today.
videos.what_to_steal: Holds price to 86% on a community vlog — the one community-format video in the set that does. It underperforms (981 views) relative to her home tours, which is at least consistent with the orientation hypothesis.
